phase_name: Measure the per-dispatch cost against the baseline

objectives.description: Measure added per-dispatch cost, with vs without surface, 10 runs each
Measure realistic multi-dispatch session total (13-dispatch and 3-dispatch cases)
Contrast against fleet-wide walk cost profile, state ratio
State scaling argument with Phase 1 numbers
Append to measurements.md, keep Phase 1 baseline intact
State ceiling up front; check for overrun

notes: Measured ~106ms added per-dispatch cost (worst-case-shaped fixture: all extensions forced STALE against real git history). Used the documented 13-dispatch BimodalLogic baseline from CLAUDE.md's own Hard Mode section for the session-level multiplier rather than inventing a count. Session totals (1.38s / 0.32s) are ~435x-1875x cheaper than the ~10-minute fleet walk. 5-second ceiling stated up front; no overrun.
